reviews.body: Excellent Service, professional barbershop, good customer service and 101 private location experience. Good conversation, Juan makes you feel comfortable all the time and the work is exceptional. I was really happy to have my haircut in here.

reviews.author: Mitchel L…
reviews.body: Juan is the most outstanding barber in town! I’ve been coming to Juan for the better part of 3 years now and I am always happy with his work. Reliability, consistency, and someone who listens to what you want are what you want in your barber and Juan exceeds all three. He has a customer for life! Thanks Juan!
